fact_types.title: Wages, tips, other compensation in box 1 of one W-2 slip: keyed by employer, tax year, and the W-2-slip thing, never by submitted evidence; two same-employer slips are two facts, and a corrected value for the same slip supersedes under this policy (ADR-0011)

Attestation that the W-2 source family is complete for tax year 2025: a determinable completeness report, not a tax election; authority is affirmative-only — only a current true value means closed, false means explicitly not closed, and no current finding means unknown (ADR-0011)
